title: Silver and gold: Potosí and Zacatecas
goal: Read how silver mining made Potosí and Zacatecas grow, and use cuanto más … más … and a medida que to say how two changes grew together.
grammar: Cuanto más … más … and a medida que

items: Use *a medida que* and *cuanto más …, más …* to say how two changes grew together.
Say what was found in the Cerro Rico in 1545 and in Zacatecas in 1546.
Explain what mercury was used for in the new method of the 1550s.
Say where the silver of Potosí and Zacatecas went.
Use the key words of mining: mine, mercury, production, wealth and ore.
